document_conflicts.description: Table ES-1 identifies 2x0 CTs as 468 MW; Schedule 8 displays 466,000 kW; Schedule 9 specifies 596.0 MW nameplate, 465 MW summer firm, and 596 MW winter firm.

Executive-summary text refers to Gulf Clean Energy Center Units 4 and 5, while one Chapter III summary says Gulf Coast Clean Energy Center Units 4 and 5. Schedule 1 and Schedule 8 use Gulf Clean Energy Center.

extraction_notes: The supplied parsed text contains the core document through printed page 427 but does not include the Appendix site-description/map pages listed in the table of contents; no unsupported site coordinates or addresses were inferred from maps.

Existing operating assets were not expanded into a full 169-unit inventory except where they are explicitly affected by a future retirement or upgrade. Schedule 1 remains the authoritative full existing-fleet roster.

Schedule 8 contains aggregate storage rows for some years while Schedule 9 identifies named projects and separate unsited planning groups. Aggregate rows are retained as planning entities rather than treated as one physical BESS.
All solar MW values identified as nameplate and all seasonal firm MW values have been kept distinct. No MWh storage-energy ratings were supplied for planned BESS facilities.
unresolved_items: Several Schedule 9 pages referenced by Schedule 8 are image-only or absent from parsed text; individual specifications for all named 2026-2029 BESS and solar projects cannot be fully recovered from the supplied extraction.

The document identifies 94 preferred sites and 38 potential sites. Preferred/potential sites not represented as separately scheduled generation additions remain site opportunities rather than committed facilities.
No energy-duration (MWh) values are stated for the planned utility-scale BESS facilities.
